# Task metadata

Status vocabulary and the Tasks-plugin metadata axes (W4-3).

- [ ] plain open
- [x] finished
- [/] rolling
- [-] dropped
- [ ] due soon 📅 2026-03-01
- [ ] scheduled later ⏳ 2026-04-15
- [ ] top priority ⏫
- [ ] high priority 🔼
- [ ] low priority 🔽
- [ ] lowest priority ⏬
- [ ] recurring 🔁 every week
- [x] full stack 📅 2026-05-01 ⏫ 🔁 every day
- [ ] malformed date 📅 not-a-date
